name: HUAWEI WATCH GT 7
summary: Huawei’s 2026 everyday smartwatch: stainless steel, dual-band GPS, IP69 and up to 21 days of battery (46 mm).

MY.note: Huawei Malaysia is taking deposits for the WATCH GT 7 series; no Malaysian launch price was found in a launch report yet.

battery.claim: Up to 21 days maximum, 12 days typical, 7 days with always-on display, 51 hours of trail-running GPS

connectivity.gps: Dual-band GNSS (GPS L1+L5, BeiDou, Galileo, GLONASS, QZSS, NavIC)
connectivity.compatibility: Android 9.0 or later, iOS 13.0 or later

default.note: Read from Huawei Malaysia’s specification page. Figures are for the 46 mm model; the 41 mm model has a 1.32-inch 466 × 466 screen (352 PPI), measures 41.3 × 41.3 × 9.99 mm and weighs about 36.5–37.6 g without strap.
